title: Offer undo through the app's shared toast, never a view-local one
rule: When a UI action offers Undo in a toast, call useToastStore().show(message, { label: 'Undo', run }) (apps/desktop/src/stores/toast.ts, rendered once by ToastMessage in App.vue). Do not add a toast, timer or toast markup to a view or its store: the shared one holds while the pointer or focus is on it, survives a route change and is the only live region at the bottom. Test the window with TOAST_MS and data-testid="toast", and add a check that the toast stays after leaving the view.
rationale: E8.3 (#88): the Problems store kept its own undo toast with a 10 s timer; it closed under the pointer, was removed when the view unmounted (store.stop()), and overlapped the activation toast that useToastStore draws.
